purpose: Canonical registry of understood review defect classes and their durable cross-PR guards.

defects.guard: structural tests require both instruction surfaces to reference the canonical registry, mode marker, and preflight command without pinning explanatory prose
.hunter-preflight-mode is read from the checked-out branch head
only pytest exit 1 is accepted as intentional RED

defects.guard_boundary: shared full preflight contract plus commit-scoped hosted evidence before review progression
defects.guard: agents run the canonical normal preflight before push and verify hosted evidence belongs to current HEAD
Mypy must pass in both normal and tests-first-red preflight

defects.source: Issue #291 pre-PR guard audit and PR #293 CodeRabbit/Codex reviews on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: artifact-validator conformance to canonical protocol without false-positive merge blockers
defects.guard: artifact guards bind checks to the canonical semantic scope, accept equivalent valid formatting, and preserve escaped Markdown delimiters such as \| inside table cells

defects.source: Issue #291 pre-PR guard audit and PR #293 CodeRabbit on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: checkout step that prepares every shared-preflight job plus merge-base resolution
defects.guard: each shared-preflight job uses a preceding full-history checkout and changed-path detection fails closed without a proven origin/main merge-base

defects.source: PR #293 CodeRabbit hostile review and Codex recurrence reviews on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: rendered-Markdown-aware artifact parsing plus hostile representation fixtures
defects.guard: non-rendered fenced/commented/indented/raw-HTML content cannot impersonate audit semantics; raw pre/script/style/textarea blocks are masked including mixed case, attributes, multiline and unclosed-to-EOF forms
FULL audits require structured per-ADR accounting while TARGETED audits remain proportionally scoped

defects.source: PR #290 Codex/CodeRabbit and PR #293 Codex P1 on 2026-08-20
defects.guard: mandatory real headings cannot be empty where substantive scope/evidence/results/derivation/completion are required, Reviewed artifact identity is mandatory, and unresolved PENDING placeholders are rejected
reviewed revision is mandatory and mutable PR/Issue/URL evidence requires a valid offset-aware evidence cutoff
only explicit prior-review/previous-finding scope triggers re-verification, which then requires references with evidence/consequence or an explicit none declaration

defects.source: PR #290 and PR #293 CodeRabbit/Codex reviews on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: architecture-audit verdict, severity, and blocking semantics
defects.guard: one canonical verdict is derived bidirectionally from unresolved severity: A permits ready/minor, B rejects READY_FOR_ADR and permits minor/conditional, C requires ADPR_REVISION_REQUIRED, D requires ARCHITECTURE_NOT_READY

defects.source: PR #290 CodeRabbit and PR #293 Codex P2 on 2026-08-20

defects.guard_boundary: all architecture-audit finding records and matrix cross-validation
defects.guard: every matrix finding, blocking or nonblocking, maps by stable Finding ID to a complete canonical finding record; record Severity and Blocks ADR must agree with the matrix
